what_this_is: The hook switchboard. Every hook script in this directory reads its own entry here before doing anything else, and exits silently when `on` is false. This is the version's shipped default; to change it on one machine without editing the plugin, set PLEXARM_HOOKS_OFF or PLEXARM_HOOKS_ON to a comma-separated list of the names below (a user's settings.json `env` reaches hook processes). OFF beats ON, and either beats this file.

session_start_credential_check.why: Silent when a token is stored; one line when it is not. Calls /records/identity only when two different Plexarm tokens are configured.

session_start_agent_sync.why: Sends the agent roster once per new session so work can be attributed. PLEXARM_AGENT_SYNC=off is the older spelling of PLEXARM_HOOKS_OFF=session_start_agent_sync.

session_start_due.why: One GET /records/board?limit=1 per new session; names what the schedule has raised for you, and prints nothing when nothing is due.

post_tool_use_dispatch.why: Installed and asking: after each Agent call it asks Plexarm whether you switched dispatch capture on in your Plexarm profile, and only then sends which agent started which. Your profile switch decides; three fields, never the prompt, and prints nothing.

subagent_start_context.why: Two sentences at spawn; no network call, no credential.

stop_record_guard.why: Off by default. PLEXARM_HOOKS_ON=stop_record_guard checks, at the end of every session and subagent, whether work was left in progress.
